title: •Changing The Odds
caption: •Changing The Odds (V)
game_text: If a player is about to draw destiny for an Epic Event, Interrupt, Objective, or weapon, that player must first activate 1 Force and shuffle their Reserve Deck. OR If both players just drew one battle destiny, cancel and redraw both destiny draws.
lore: Qui-Gon used his Jedi abilities to insure that there was no ‘chance’ involved with the use of Watto’s chance cube.
